data.name: Hemlatha
data.long_meaning: Hemlatha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hema’ which means gold or wealth and ‘latha’ which means flow. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name Hemlatha brings good fortune and abundance in one's life.
